note: fromTeller gives the lower bounds (as gaps), the exponential jet bounds for A, A^{-1}, Gamma and their principal compressions, and the e^{-cB} discrepancy bounds; Offset.prices gives the mean bound C t and the residual bound, with an extra factor t. The weights upsilon_i^r and the constants are packaged in RatesPaid/Parcel rather than written out.

theorem fromTeller (P : Patch) (G : Gauge) (p : Teller G) (hB : P.Branches p.bind G) (k : ℕ) :
    ∃ C r σ b η g : ℝ, 0<C ∧ 0<r ∧ 0<σ ∧ 0<b ∧ 0<η ∧ 0<g ∧ ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop,
      Sky G p P x C r k σ b η g := by

theorem prices (G : Gauge) (P : Patch) (Pt : Teller G) (B : ℝ) (hB : 0<B) (q : Chi) (n : ℕ) (hP : P.Branches Pt.bind G) :
    ∃ r d d' v M N η l : ℝ, 0<r ∧ 0<d ∧ 0<d' ∧ 0<v ∧ 0<M ∧ 0<N ∧ 0<η ∧ 0<l ∧
    ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in atTop, 120 ≤ radiusB x ∧ ∀ {c f : Side} (S : StepData c f) (T : Tube G S), S.patch=P →
    100*(1+radiusB x) ≤ c.val → Pt.Funds S T → ∀ (A : Stores S) (F : Forest S.ratio) (V : Config G c),
    V∈eligible A G x → ∀ k : S.Choices,
      (∀ z : PriceCoords G c, ‖z‖≤r → Estimate n d' v η l N A F T x V k z) ∧
        Shift n x d v (B*fiery G x S.patch.L) M T F A V k q := by
